article.title: Ethio Telecom Density And Financial Report for 2021/2022
article.description: The telecommunication penetration rate, also known as telecom density, measures the percentage of the population that has access to telecommunication services. In the case of Ethiopia, the telecom density increased from 54.8% in 2020/21 to 63.3% in 2021/22.
